messages:
sahil: Following the outage postmortem  creating an action list for vendor/cloud/model-registry/auth mitigations. Please ack + ETA. I'll summarize for the exec follow-up.

maria: Ack. I'll own registry geo-replication (metadata checksums + async blob sync). Design doc Tue, PoC in 2 sprints.

alex: I can take auth fallback (cached JWKS + token-bridge signed by our KMS). PoC Fri EOD, unit tests next week.

anne: I'll handle vendor SLA/escalation language and request for a dedicated AE. Draft to legal + vendor-CS by Wed.

julie: Ops preference: automatic fallback to onboarded local quantized model for public routes with circuit-breaker. I'll make packaging + QA checklist.

ops-oncall: I'll add cross-region synthetics and a Grafana panel. Staging by next Tue; prod after 48h stable. Scheduling DR drill for Tue 09:00 PT  RSVP.

devops-bot: Created tickets:
```
INF-3720 registry-geo-repl (assignee: maria)
INF-3721 auth-fallback-bridge (assignee: alex)
INF-3722 vendor-sla-runbook (assignee: anne)
INF-3723 cross-region-synthetics (assignee: ops-oncall)
```
Links: https://jira.redwoodinfra/INF-3721

sahil: Action owners noted. Requirement: weekly Jira updates, auth_fallback_rate metric + fallback_success_ratio alert, and vendor AE confirmation in 7 days. Flag blockers here before infra sync.

maria: Note: need small schema change for checksum and backfill plan. Will include rollback steps in doc.

alex: Security note: fallback tokens TTL short and include fallback_reason claim. We'll avoid vendor key storage.

anne: Vendor update: verbal AE commitment, legal suggested minor edits; final wording to sales by Wed.

julie: Adding tests for hallucination/regression with fallback model and cold start checks.

ops-oncall: RSVP'd for DR drill. Will run auth-down + registry-read-error scenarios and capture runbook timings.

sahil: Thanks. I'll post a 1-line daily status until PoCs are in staging. Reopen if vendor/legal blockers appear.
